# echo11 — Product Engineering Studio

> A product engineering studio based in Nepal. We help businesses plan, design, and build websites, platforms, portals, and digital products with clear process and dependable execution.

## What we do

Echo11 provides integrated product strategy, interface design, and engineering delivery. We work with founders and teams who need reliable digital products — from early-stage planning through launch and ongoing support.

### Services

- **Website Design & Build** — Custom websites built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Focused on speed, trust, and conversion.
- **App Development** — Web and mobile products using React Native, Expo, PWA architecture, and API design.
- **Performance & SEO** — Core Web Vitals optimization, technical SEO audits, image optimization, caching strategy, and CDN configuration.
- **Maintenance Retainer** — Ongoing support for security updates, bug fixes, feature additions, monitoring, and priority support.

## How we work

Our delivery process follows five phases: Discovery, Planning, Design, Build, and Launch. We set clear timelines, milestones, and communication standards at the start of every engagement.

## Case studies

- **TrueLuxe Nepal** — Premium e-commerce platform for skincare discovery with local payment integration and mobile-first performance.
- **The Leaders NP** — Nepal history, political, and social platform with structured editorial workflows and data-backed storytelling.
- **curriculum.os** — Curriculum planning platform for educators and learning teams to organize programs, modules, and delivery details.
